stations.title: Theo
stations.say: Can the laptop keep the cards?

stations.title: Card box
stations.text: Paper cards, sold out written in pencil.

captions: Lists work now. Next, Theo wants the candle cards he keeps on paper on the laptop.
Every card lives in a box behind the counter, and the site cannot read any of them.
You keep each candle as an object, then read it, sell from it and restock it.
When Ines pours more sage, its card loses the sold out mark and shows the new stock.
A candle is one value with named parts now, ready for a whole catalogue.
